title: Shared definitions (contracts v1)
description: Building blocks referenced by every other contract. Not a message on its own.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Incompatible changes bump it (CLAUDE.md). Every contract is at 1.0 unless it names its own version below.

body_schema_version.description: Body config contract version. 2.0 (D-37): collider footprint, sensor mount height, arms, gestures and expression channels; radius_m removed; robot kinds renamed.

gesture.description: Bounded gesture vocabulary (Blueprint §10.3, ART_DIRECTION §6). A body config lists which of these it can perform (D-36); the action gate rejects the rest. SIT_IN_PLACE is a posture in place, not sitting on a chair (that is INTERACT with affordance SIT). HAND_OVER offers a held object.

expression_channel.description: Ways a body can express itself (D-14, D-19). SPEECH: voice, shown as a text bubble in RANGE. FACE: a readable face (a person's face, or a robot's visor glyph display). LIGHT: a Beacon light strip or visor light.

track_id.description: Anonymous track ID, scoped to one recipient and one session. Never derived reversibly from the true entity ID.

time_ms.description: Simulation time in milliseconds. Non-negative integer.

validity.description: Measurement status (Addendum v0.2 §2). Missing or stale evidence is never reported as 0 or calm.

read_label.description: Qualitative read on an interpretation (D-10). Not a probability.

baseline_scope.description: Where a ΔP baseline comes from (Addendum v0.2 §2). NONE means no baseline exists.

layer_mask.description: Perception mask: which HORIZON layers are active (D-03). L0 cannot be bypassed.

point3.description: World position in meters, Godot convention: x and z on the floor, y up (D-29).

point2.description: Floor position in meters (x, z), Godot convention (D-29).

pose.description: Floor pose. yaw_rad is Godot's rotation.y: 0 faces -z, positive turns left (D-29).

evaluator_only_field.description: Field names that exist only on the evaluator side (D-13, Atlas §7). No agent-facing contract may declare or accept them. Godot uses this same list.
